title: Recipe
description: One file in recipes/, filed under the first letter of its stem. The file stem is the recipe's id and must be lowercase snake_case.

name.description: Display name, unique across the database.

tags.description: Keywords used to filter the index, such as 'Vegetarian' or 'Dessert'.

measurements.description: The ingredients and their amounts, in the order they are incorporated.

instructions.description: Steps, one string each, in order.

notes.description: Free-form notes distinct from the instructions, such as warnings about common mistakes.

amount.description: A non-negative number (usually quoted, e.g. '76'), or 'enough' for an unmeasured amount.

unit.description: Required unless the amount is 'enough', which has no unit.

prefix.description: Preparation shown before the ingredient, e.g. 'minced'.

suffix.description: Qualifier shown after the ingredient, written as a continuation, e.g. ', room temperature'.

recipe.description: File stem of the recipe this ingredient is made from, when it is one. Must exist in recipes/ and must not be this recipe.
